tasks.short: Consult on climatological information for predictions and warnings

steps.what: Find and verify the actual climatological source material and consultation question
inputs: Actual question from another office, agency or researcher
Existing source datasets and documentation maintained by their owners
outputs: Checked consultation context, source versions and limitations

steps.what: Consult with the actual office, agency, professional or researcher on using and interpreting climatological information for weather predictions and warnings
inputs: Checked actual source context
Other professionals' actual interpretation questions
outputs: Human scientific consultation and agreed interpretation limits

steps.what: Capture the actual required consultation working note and check its complete interpretation, sources and uncertainty
inputs: Actual scientific discussion from s2
Checked source identifiers

steps.what: Save the exact checked consultation working note
inputs: Exact complete note checked in s3

tasks.design: Configure native {DATA_PLATFORM} source views and fixed source identifiers in a {DOCS} consultation-note form. The scientist retains the scientific discussion and actual note writing and checks the complete note before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Source navigation and repeated identifiers can add effort around actual scientific consultation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native dataset links and forms can reduce navigation and fixed-field entry.
tasks.still_hard: The meaning and limits of climatological information require professional interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: Explain uncertainty and recognise inappropriate uses in a prediction or warning context.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native dataset views and note fields can support source lookup while scientific consultation remains human work.

assumptions: Conditional consultation episode with an actual required working note, not invented documentation after every exchange or a measured task mix.
Dataset owners produce existing source material; scientist retrieval, source/version checking and actual discussion capture are counted in s1-s3. No free scientific summary or cleaned feed.
Native features first; existing views and fixed fields earn zero saving. s3 reduces source identifiers only, not interpretation wording or the full final check.

Save is negligible and fully retained. No forecast or warning is generated or issued; any actual external briefing document, forecast or warning send needs its complete final-version check and separate action.
All 100 illustrative focal points: gross 3 plus 1.9 equals 4.9, less upkeep 1 gives net 3.9.
unknowns: Actual note practice and source-view availability
research_questions: Which source navigation and identifier entry remain manual during actual consultations?

already_counted.description: Retained source checks and actual note capture and full final scientific checking

incremental.description: Maintain dataset links and fixed source fields

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete consultation note checked in s3; any edit requires recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional lookup and source-identifier saving 4.9 less upkeep 1; actual interpretation and consultation retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Speak publicly about weather and answer questions

steps.what: Find and verify actual source information for the public's weather topic or questions
inputs: Actual audience topic or questions
Existing source observations and explanatory material
outputs: Checked source material with actual time and uncertainty context

steps.what: Prepare the actual scientific explanation and decide what the evidence supports for this audience
inputs: Actual topic and verified source material

steps.what: Speak to the public, discuss actual weather topics and answer live questions
inputs: Actual audience and questions
Scientist's checked explanation and source understanding
outputs: Live scientific explanation and discussion of uncertainty

tasks.design: Use native {DATA_PLATFORM} and {DOCS} source links for public-speaking preparation. The scientist determines the explanation and retains live speaking and question answering.
tasks.previous_blocker: Source navigation can repeat before public explanations.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source views can reduce that specific navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding the audience and explaining changing evidence require live judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Respond to the actual question and explain uncertainty clearly.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native source lookup can support weather explanations while scientific preparation and live public speaking remain human.

assumptions: Conditional prepared public-discussion episode, not measured baseline for every spontaneous question. Source owners produce material; scientist verification and actual explanation preparation are counted in s1-s2.
Native features first; existing links earn zero saving. No generated forecast, model explanation or scripted answer is substituted for scientific understanding.

No separate slides, written reply, public post, registration send or event report is established by this task. If actual artefacts or sends exist, include their preparation, final checks and separate actions rather than silently removing them.
All 100 illustrative focal points: gross lookup saving 3 less upkeep 1 gives net 2.
unknowns: Actual public-speaking format and current source access
research_questions: Which repeated source navigation remains after current tools?

already_counted.description: Retained source checking and actual scientific explanation preparation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional preparation lookup saving 3 less upkeep 1; scientific preparation and public speech retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Apply meteorological knowledge to environmental issues

steps.what: Define the actual environmental question and collect and verify meteorological datasets, units and analysis assumptions
inputs: Actual global-warming, pollution-control or ozone question
Existing observation datasets and source documentation produced by their owners
outputs: Scientist-checked data extracts, explicit groupings/formulas and evidence limitations

steps.what: Stage checked extracts and calculate exact descriptive meteorological tables using the scientist's explicit units, periods and formulas
inputs: Checked data and explicit calculations from s1
outputs: Traceable data tables and missing/unit-mismatch exceptions

steps.what: Apply meteorological knowledge to interpret the actual environmental issue, assess methods and uncertainties and determine supported findings
inputs: Actual environmental question
Original evidence and traceable tables
outputs: Scientist's environmental analysis and qualified findings

steps.what: Write the actual scientific findings and check the complete analysis record, calculations, sources and uncertainty wording
inputs: Actual scientific analysis from s3
Source data and calculations

steps.what: Save the exact checked environmental analysis
inputs: Exact complete analysis checked in s4

tasks.design: Configure native {DATA_PLATFORM} extract and descriptive-table operations from scientist-checked data and explicit formulas. The scientist applies meteorological knowledge and writes and checks the complete {DOCS} analysis before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual extract handling and table assembly can repeat exact data operations within an analysis.
tasks.enabler_now: Native data operations can preserve exact source provenance and explicit calculation definitions.
tasks.still_hard: Scientific applicability, environmental mechanisms and uncertainty require expert reasoning.
tasks.human_edge: Decide what the data can support for the particular environmental question.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native data-platform operations can assemble explicit descriptive tables from checked meteorological data without interpreting environmental causes.

assumptions: Representative environmental analysis episode with actual manual extract/table work and a findings record; not a measured baseline or a universal mix across all climate, pollution and ozone work.

Station, satellite and dataset owners produce existing observations; scientist collection, source checking, field capture and formula definitions are counted in s1. Missing or incompatible evidence remains manual; no free new observation feed.
Native operations first. Current data pipelines, simulation runtime and unattended computation are baseline and earn zero new saving; s2 replaces demonstrated active manual data handling only.
No automatic causal attribution, scientific forecast or model-generated finding. All method and meaning judgements and actual report writing remain human.

Save is negligible and fully retained. No external report submission, warning, policy instruction or operational action is hidden; any actual send needs a complete final-version check and separate action.
All 100 illustrative focal points: gross data-assembly saving 25 less upkeep 4 gives net 21.
unknowns: Current native data pipelines and actual active manual handling
research_questions: Which exact extract and table operations still consume active scientist time after existing pipelines?

already_counted.description: Source/formula verification, complete scientific interpretation and actual findings writing and final review

incremental.description: Maintain explicit data mappings and validate calculation definitions when datasets change

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete environmental analysis checked in s4; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional active manual data-assembly saving 25 less upkeep 4; existing runtime and all scientific reasoning retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan staff work and communicate the actual schedule

steps.what: Collect and verify actual office workload, staff availability, expertise and coverage constraints
inputs: Existing staff availability and expertise records
Actual office work and coverage needs
Staff-provided constraints
outputs: Scientist-checked planning facts and explicitly captured constraints

steps.what: Create the actual work schedule and match staff expertise to situations, resolving coverage and development tradeoffs with staff
inputs: Checked workload and staff constraints from s1

steps.what: Fill exact selected staff, task and time fields into the native draft roster and matching staff notice
inputs: Actual selected assignments captured in s2
Explicit roster and notice field mapping
outputs: Complete draft roster and staff notice with identity/coverage discrepancies marked

steps.what: Check the complete final roster, expertise coverage, times and exact staff notice and recipients
inputs: Complete draft roster and notice from s3
Actual chosen assignments and staff constraints
outputs: Exact checked final roster and staff notice

steps.what: Commit the exact checked work schedule in the shared planning record
inputs: Exact complete roster checked in s4

steps.what: Send the exact checked schedule notice to the named internal staff
inputs: Exact final notice and recipient list checked in s4
Actual schedule saved in s5

steps.what: Brief and support staff on actual assignments and respond to implementation questions
inputs: Actual staff and work schedule
outputs: Human management support and any identified need for a revised plan

tasks.design: Configure native {PROJECT} roster fields and {CALENDAR} links for assignments chosen by the scientist. The scientist checks the complete schedule and notice before separate save and {EMAIL} send actions and retains active staff management.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manually assembling a chosen roster and notice can repeat captured assignments.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms and exact field mappings can stage selected staff and times.
tasks.still_hard: Expertise matching, coverage tradeoffs and staff development require managerial judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Understand staff capability and balance competing work needs.

ambition.what: Support existing schedule creation and communication.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native roster fields can stage exact human-selected assignments while managerial judgement and staff support remain human work.

assumptions: Representative work-scheduling and expertise-matching management episode with actual roster assembly and staff notice; not a measured baseline for all training or office-performance duties. Observe the real duty mix before generalizing.

Personnel and work owners produce existing records; scientist collection, staff consultation and explicit assignment capture are fully counted in s1-s2. Missing constraints remain manual, with no inferred competency or employee scoring.
Native configuration first; existing scheduling features earn no new saving. s3 automates only exact roster/notice assembly, not assignments or managerial decisions.

Any actual employee consultation or owner authorization required for the scheduling change must inspect the completed final version before publication, with its labour added; build consent/access includes that consultation setup.
Complete final artefacts exist before s4. Changed assignments or recipient lists require renewed checking before the affected save or send. Neither near-zero save nor retained send earns saving.
Training and office performance analysis remain their actual human duties; no hidden training completion or employee appraisal is inferred from this schedule.
All 100 illustrative focal points: gross assembly saving 20 less upkeep 3 gives net 17.
unknowns: Actual scheduling authority, employee consultation and native roster features
research_questions: Which roster and notice fields are still assembled manually after existing planning tools?

already_counted.description: Actual planning-source capture, expertise and coverage decisions and complete final schedule/notice check

incremental.description: Maintain native roster mappings and validate schedule/notice consistency

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete roster checked in s4; assignment or time changes require recheck
Exact complete schedule notice and recipients checked in s4 for the saved roster; changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional manual roster/notice assembly saving 20 less upkeep 3; all managerial decisions and active staff support retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
